内存实验项目存储后端
device_entry.description: 这是一个用于显微成像采集流程的软件数据存储组件，在 RAM 中保存多维图像及其元数据，并按通道、Z 层、时间点、位置、行列等坐标建立索引，便于实验过程中快速判断图像是否存在、读取图像内容以及读取对应元数据。
device_entry.description_en: This is a software data storage component for microscopy acquisition workflows. It stores multidimensional images and their metadata in RAM and indexes them by coordinates such as channel, z, time, position, row, and column for fast checking, retrieval of image data, and retrieval of metadata during experiments.
